chapter: Jelly Roll Morton and Oliver anecdotes
title: Joe Oliver's brick and his pistol at rehearsal
summary: Allen relays a story of Oliver using a brick to cue the band; Moore describes Oliver bringing a pistol to rehearsals while Dave Nelson ran them. A tape restart follows.
